title: The sync range leak gate exempts any value the private query-log store already holds, so a store GUID copied into a public file passes sync and then blocks publish
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks counts a value as already public only when a file that publish's projection keeps holds it, so a value only the query-log store or a _logs.csv holds is refused by the sync leak gate; the sync gate reads no public-values cache that publish's scan filled
